newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Krung Thai Bank US$100 mln FRCD allotted.
newsitem.headline: Krung Thai Bank US$100 mln FRCD allotted.

text.p: Krung Thai Bank's US$100 million floating rate certificate of deposit issue has been allotted, one of the arrangers said.
The five-year facility which has no put or call options, was priced at par to float at 35 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 42 basis points.
Arrangers with US$17.5 million each, are Asahi Finance Hong Kong, Bankgesellschaft Berlin, BZW Asia and Nomura International Hong Kong.
Lead managers with US$7 million each, are Dresdner Bank AG Provincial International Banking Facility Rayong, and WestLB.
Co-lead managers with US$5 million each, are Oversea-Chinese Banking Corp and Overseas Union Bank.
Co-managers with US$3 million each are Bank of Nova Scotia International Banking Facility and AFC Merchant Bank.
